releases.body:
Initial release. Desktop notifications for OpenCode with click-to-focus via OSC 99.

- Kitty enhanced path: `kitty @ ls` → PID → PTY discovery for precise tab/split focus
- Generic OSC 99 fallback: process tree walking for any compliant terminal
- Events: session status changes, permission requests, cost limit warnings
- Published to npm: `@markarranz/opencode-focus-notify`
